history.feelings: Overwhelming stress from work and a sense of loneliness led to increased alcohol use.
Feelings of despair after a relationship breakup triggered a relapse into substance use.
A celebration for a promotion turned into a binge that reignited addictive behaviors.
Isolation during a cold winter caused a period of heavy substance use to cope with depression.
Decided to seek help and began a journey towards recovery, feeling hopeful but anxious about the future.
